# Best Time to Visit Nadi (NAN), Fiji

The **best time to visit Nadi, Fiji is from late May to early October** — Fiji's dry season (also called the "Fijian winter").

## Why This Time Is Ideal

**Weather:**
- Temperatures are pleasantly warm (24–28°C / 75–82°F)
- Lower humidity makes it more comfortable
- Minimal rainfall and lots of sunshine
- Calmer seas with excellent visibility (great for diving and snorkeling)

**Reduced Risks:**
- Outside the cyclone season (which runs November–April)
- Fewer mosquitoes due to drier conditions

**Activities:**
- Ideal for island-hopping to the Mamanuca and Yasawa Islands
- Best conditions for surfing at Cloudbreak (June–August)
- Excellent diving with up to 30m visibility
- Great for hiking and outdoor exploration

## Shoulder Season Tip
**May and October** offer a sweet spot — good weather, fewer crowds, and lower prices compared to peak July–August (which coincides with Australian and NZ school holidays).

## When to Avoid
**January–March:** Peak wet season with heavy rain, high humidity, and cyclone risk. However, this period offers the lushest scenery and lowest prices if you don't mind the weather.

## Quick Recommendation
Aim for **June or September** for the best balance of weather, value, and fewer crowds.
